method: Read-only replay of selected recorded HTTP sequences; game events are independent audit labels, not candidate runtime inputs. Adjacent resolver/player means adjacent request starts, not proof of a new play. Null times remain unknown. Counts describe this selected dataset, not frequency in normal use.
limitations: 1113/06 requests1-4 belong to preceding media and are excluded.
01/N10R and02/manual4598 retain original timing/cache limitations; first observed request is not proof of first request in playback lifetime.
Player/resolver labels are inherited from source evidence; User-Agent distinguishes observed client families, not unique users.
No inference of delivered video bytes from error-response bodies.
